notes: Learner-facing title/description and intentional progression only. Original lesson IDs, source text, original MP3s, XP, sound focus, number practice groups, reading sequence and progress keys must not change. The Świętokrzyska lab is a diagnostic tool outside the three curriculum stages.

lessons.title: L and Ł
lessons.description: Hear the difference between Polish L and Ł in real words.

lessons.title: C, CZ and Ć
lessons.description: Compare three Polish consonant sounds in recorded words.

lessons.title: S, SZ and Ś
lessons.description: Hear the contrasts between S, SZ and Ś or SI in everyday words.

lessons.title: Z, Ż/RZ and Ź/ZI
lessons.description: Compare the plain, deeper and softer Z-family sounds in context.

lessons.title: KRZY and PRZY
lessons.description: Listen for these challenging consonant clusters inside complete expressions.

lessons.title: Numbers 1-20
lessons.description: Learn the first twenty numbers, with optional practice in two groups of ten.

lessons.title: Numbers Beyond 20
lessons.description: Build number vocabulary with tens, combinations and larger values up to 1,020.

lessons.title: Streets and Road Words
lessons.description: Name roads, squares, intersections and common features of Polish streets.

lessons.title: Warsaw Districts and Landmarks
lessons.description: Recognize Warsaw districts and a few familiar local landmarks.

lessons.title: Cities of Poland
lessons.description: Hear and practise the names of Polish cities, from Warszawa to smaller centres.

lessons.title: Polish First and Last Names
lessons.description: Get comfortable hearing and saying common Polish personal names.

lessons.title: Countries in Polish
lessons.description: Learn Polish names for countries across Europe and the wider world.

lessons.title: Greetings and Introductions
lessons.description: Say hello and goodbye, use polite words and introduce yourself.

lessons.title: Shopping: Useful Questions
lessons.description: Ask prices, discuss payment and make simple shopping requests.

lessons.title: Ordering at a Restaurant
lessons.description: Ask for food and drinks, make requests and handle the bill.

lessons.title: Eating Out: Tables and Food
lessons.description: Ask for a table, describe food preferences and respond at a restaurant.

lessons.title: Asking for Directions
lessons.description: Ask how to get somewhere and understand everyday directions.

lessons.title: Public Transport Phrases
lessons.description: Ask about stops, tickets, routes and getting around by public transport.

lessons.title: Health and Emergency Phrases
lessons.description: Ask for urgent help, describe common problems and request medical assistance.

lessons.title: Everyday Conversations: Greetings
lessons.description: Read greetings and introductions, then practise two short exchanges.

lessons.title: At the Grocery Store
lessons.description: Follow a simple apple purchase, then practise the customer-assistant exchange.

lessons.title: Buying Clothes: A T-Shirt
lessons.description: Read a clothing-store interaction about sizes, fitting rooms and paying.

lessons.title: On the Tram: A Conversation
lessons.description: Follow a passenger asking about seats, stops and the city centre.

lessons.title: Asking a Tram Driver
lessons.description: Read questions about destinations, stops and buying a ticket on the tram.

lessons.title: At the Museum
lessons.description: Practise a museum visit, including tickets, opening hours and finding exhibitions.

lessons.title: Świętokrzyska Pronunciation Lab
lessons.description: Try recording a difficult Warsaw place name; reference audio and pronunciation guide still need review.
